recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5202 unless a future PA decision reopens the broader EpisodeOfCare/Encounter boundary wording.
issue_request: FHIR-5202 is a Published/Persuasive PA change request from the January 2015 ballot for FHIR-core EpisodeOfCare. It asked to replace the EpisodeOfCare/Encounter boundary phrase "a specific problem/issue" with "problems/issues" because an episode can address multiple problems and the resource allowed repeating condition-related content.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit f659c3fbc16870414aac80f798d75afcb5480bf8, "Ballot reconciliation updates for EpisodeOfCare," on 2015-03-25. Git pickaxe shows that commit removed the old phrase and added "problems/issues" in source/episodeofcare/episodeofcare-introduction.xml, although the commit did not name FHIR-5202.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists episodeofcare=EpisodeOfCare, so the source/episodeofcare narrative is in current build scope. Later edits changed adjacent wording, including "patient" to "patient(s)," but left the FHIR-5202 plural problem wording intact. FHIR-3915 was found as a neighboring EpisodeOfCare/Encounter boundary Jira, but it concerns linkage-direction clarity rather than the plural problem wording and was not decided here. FHIR-5202-specific Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/episodeofcare/episodeofcare-introduction.xml says an EpisodeOfCare links Encounters "together for problems/issues," and source/episodeofcare/structuredefinition-EpisodeOfCare.xml remains consistent with multiple reasons/diagnoses.

related_jiras.note: Another Published EpisodeOfCare/Encounter boundary wording issue found by exact-wording Jira search; it concerns clarifying how Encounters link to EpisodeOfCare, not FHIR-5202's plural problems/issues wording.
